milestone: A4 first autonomous bounded learner falsification
decision: Implement one16-coordinate joint square-root EKF, preserve full state/parameter correlation, then one small paired lifecycle run. No hyperparameter sweep or after-result tuning.

candidate.name: scm_online
candidate.representation: Mean16 plus full square covariance factorS16x16, P=S*S^T; factor is not required triangular. Fixed state/workspace; no rawhistory or cached rows.
candidate.belief_semantics: Local Gaussian, prior-conditioned approximation to sequential nonlinear inference. Historical information is carried in mean/full factor and dynamics; no exact nonlinear historical likelihood or hard support/coverage claim.
candidate.prior_means: Original public defaulttheta start0: geometric-mid tau bands, gamma150/300,Q.06,z.68. Legacy linear-QP public seed R0/R1/R2/R3=.1,H=.024; currentv1/v2/v3/h=0. No fitted M1 estimates or true values.
candidate.prior_standard_deviations: Support-coordinate width/sqrt12: log tau bands [.015,.15],[.15,1.5],[1.5,30]; loggamma[5,1200]; logQ[.03,.10]; R[0,1],H[0,.1],enteringz[.2,.95],enteringv[-.08,.08],h[-1,1]. Diagonal initial factor; this is a declared Gaussian scale, not a uniform-support guarantee.
candidate.prediction: Every actual interval updates physical z/v/h and S_pred=F*S using sparse analytic F; static parameter rows identity. No process noise, fading or forgetting in matched static model.
candidate.correction: Each available voltage enters once at interval end. Full-factor scalar Joseph-equivalent update with normalized innovation, preserving correlations. No replay/optimizer/posterior factor added.
candidate.domain_policy: Common gain multiplier lambda in[0,1] keeps corrected means in declared supports. If limited, tiny fixed interior backoff1-1e-9. Covariance uses the same scaled gain via Joseph-equivalent factor update. lambda0 preserves predicted belief exactly. Report all limited/zero-gain corrections. Prediction/domain/numerical loss is explicit, never replaced by invented current/state.
candidate.factor_formula: w=S^T*h; innovation_sd=hypot(sigma,w_0,...,w_15); u=w/innovation_sd; g=S*u; c=lambda*(2-lambda); delta=(sigma/innovation_sd)^2+(1-lambda)^2*dot(u,u); a=c/(1+sqrt(delta)); mean+=lambda*g*(innovation/innovation_sd); S_new=S-a*g*u^T.
candidate.mean_support: Static original supports; current z[0,1],v_i[-.25,.25]V,h[-1,1]. Support checking constrains means; covariance remains local approximate, not truncated posterior.
candidate.work: Fixed O(16²) per sample; sparse dynamics, no per-sample QR, no age-dependent iterations. Measure actual kernel/storage/host cost; no M23 claim.

execution.primary_run_policy: Run once after source/plan commit. Preserve first outputs and any failures. No full-cell learning during development. Tiny deterministic numerical/fault fixtures are separately disclosed.
execution.truth_policy: Inference runner/CLI receives observations and public configuration only. Separate scorer loads truth after every inference process has finished.
execution.checkpoint: Fixed-size complete canonical state, no pointer/rawjournal. Warmrestore makes no numerical updates and preserves state/factor/config/counters exactly.
execution.cold: Restorecontrol900s then discardbelief and initialize the declared public prior while plant continues. Source position and known absoluteclock retained; no true hidden state.

acceptance.functional: Every declared process/delivery completes with explicit finite-state/ordering/lifecycle semantics; exact warmcheckpoint and queryparity excludingruntime timings. No silently lost physical updates or duplicated observation evidence.
acceptance.resource: No heap in inference kernel, no rawhistory, owned persistent/workspace/query bytes constant from first tolast observation; practical initial owned budget8192B before stack/runtime/persistence extras. Record all additional simultaneous costs.
acceptance.qualification: Report prior-conditioned localSD, excitation/reasons/constraints and actual point errors separately. Local2sigma widths are not a hard-error guarantee. Count hard-limit breaches among provisional savedqueries; report first/sustained and fraction unavailable/unresolved.
acceptance.comparison_reference: Frozen M1 outputs at samepositions, plus supplemental new-threshold and fullbelief audit. No rerun of M1 solver.
acceptance.decision: Keep as a candidate only if hard target/lifecycle/resource gates pass without hidden numerical faults; record preferred-region performance separately. If it fails, stop and name one measured cause for the next bounded change. Do not launch annual/attention/multistart experiments automatically.

risk: One Gaussian may collapse into a wrong nonlinear mode. Common domain-limited gain can stall allcoordinates at one nuisancebound. Preserve counters and firstfailure; no after-score processnoise/priorretuning.
proof_scope: Review square-factor algebra and finite numerical kernel/fault tests. A factor representation preserves real-arithmetic PSD; it does not prove full-model all-prefix accuracy/coverage, clock/counter availability or target lifetime stability.
prior_evidence_preserved: All M1/reference/compact/certificate sources and frozen evidence unchanged. New supplemental thresholds do not rewrite old acceptance.
research_source: https://ipnpr.jpl.nasa.gov/progress_report/42-233/42-233A.pdf; general square-root filtering context, own scalar Joseph-equivalent algebra separately reviewed.
